title: Start a live meeting from Grillo: the control that launches the meeting agent
story: The Map tab's Tickets card now has a "Start meeting" button beside "Add ticket" and "Run tagging round". Before this, no screen could start a live meeting, so the meeting panel could not be reached. The button starts the live session's meeting agent and opens its tab on the meeting panel; while any meeting agent runs on the laptop it reopens that agent instead of starting a second, and it is hidden on an archived project.

checks.criterion: Pressing "Start meeting" starts a meeting agent with /grillo-meeting, opens its tab, and the tab shows the meeting panel.
checks.steps: Open a made-up project such as example-org/sample-project-1 that has at least one open ticket and is not archived. Open the Map tab. In the Tickets card header, press "Start meeting".
checks.expected: A new agent tab named "Grilling · Live session" becomes active and shows the meeting panel (Present, Consent, Record, preparing speech model).

checks.criterion: While a meeting agent is running on this laptop, for any project, the button opens that agent's tab instead of starting a second one.
checks.steps: Do the start-meeting check. Go back to the Map tab and press "Start meeting" again. Open the Map tab of a second made-up project, example-org/sample-project-2, and press "Start meeting". Stop the meeting agent, go back to a Map tab, and press "Start meeting".
checks.expected: The second and third presses both open the same "Grilling · Live session" tab, with no second meeting tab in the tab bar. After the agent is stopped, the last press starts a new meeting agent.

checks.criterion: The button is hidden on a closed (archived) project.
checks.steps: On a made-up project where you are a repository admin, open the Map tab. Press "Close project". Press "Reopen".
checks.expected: After closing, the Tickets header shows only the greyed-out "Add ticket" and "Run tagging round", with no "Start meeting". After reopening, "Start meeting" is back and can be pressed.
